recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to the sample copay terminology should be handled through THO/UTG rather than by adding core CodeSystem source back to the FHIR repository.
issue_request: FHIR-15563 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked Financial Management to add the Copay structure to Coverage from the Dec 2017 ballot and add Televisit to the current copay list.
initial_application: The Dec 2017 ballot-preparation commit 4251af7d60629fdcd0051f1c47a1edac71416304 added Coverage.copay, Coverage.copay.type, Coverage.copay.value, and the initial coverage-copay-type terminology source. The Jira-tagged commit 8f5e8739dc6dfa0edfae82f9d09b26f6f0e7b02a retained those copay rows while applying Coverage ballot material. A following terminology commit, 49ee52b963abadc71e75fff3c1f5e31e86d25d30, added the televisit concept to the same copay CodeSystem.
additional_context: Coverage is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Coverage work renamed and broadened Coverage.copay into Coverage.costToBeneficiary, preserving the copay/payment meaning while adding category, network, unit, term, value[x], and exception detail. Later issue-reconcile commits already represented FHIR-18122 and FHIR-27024 on the combined branch; those changes refine Coverage.costToBeneficiary.exception without reversing the seed request. The copay CodeSystem moved out of core during UTG/THO cleanup, while core still references http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/coverage-copay-type through the active value set.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/coverage/structuredefinition-Coverage.xml already defines the requested patient copay/card detail as Coverage.costToBeneficiary, source/coverage/coverage-example-2.xml demonstrates the structure, and the current THO CodeSystem contains the televisit code.

related_jiras.note: Shared the historical Tracker #15563/#15564 Coverage ballot application commit, but concerned Coverage.class/grouping and is already represented separately on the combined branch.

Added the value-or-exception invariant for Coverage.costToBeneficiary and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
